class.name: InstanceGroup3D
class.brief_description: Many copies of a mesh that move, drawn in chunks of the world.
class.description: Draws thousands of copies of [member mesh] that move every frame (a crowd, units, bullets, a flock). The game gives every copy's transform in one call a frame with [member transforms]; the copies are sorted into a grid of [member chunk_size] cells, each drawn as its own MultiMesh. Chunks off screen, out of the sun's shadow range or past [member visibility_range_end] cost nothing, and an imported mesh's simpler levels of detail are drawn for chunks far away. A single [MultiMeshInstance3D] is drawn whole whenever any copy is in view. Changes made in a frame are drawn once, at the end of it. The chunks are this node's: they follow its transform and visibility, and [WorldOrigin] shifts. [codeblock] var floats := PackedFloat32Array() for fish in shoal: var t: Transform3D = fish.transform floats.append_array([t.basis.x.x, t.basis.y.x, t.basis.z.x, t.origin.x, t.basis.x.y, t.basis.y.y, t.basis.z.y, t.origin.y, t.basis.x.z, t.basis.y.z, t.basis.z.z, t.origin.z]) $Shoal.transforms = floats [/codeblock]

method.name: get_chunk_count
method.description: Returns how many chunks the copies are drawn in: one for each [member chunk_size] cell with a copy in it, and a draw call each (and more for shadows).

method.name: get_count
method.description: Returns how many copies there are: the size of [member transforms] divided by 12.

members.member: Whether the copies cast shadows, as [member GeometryInstance3D.cast_shadow].
The size of the cells the copies are drawn in, in metres. Larger chunks draw fewer, bigger batches; smaller ones are culled more closely. Changing it sorts the copies again.

Each copy's colour, in order, when [member use_colors] is on, for the material to read (with [member BaseMaterial3D.vertex_color_use_as_albedo], or [code]COLOR[/code] in a shader). Copies without one are white.
Four numbers for each copy, in order, when [member use_custom_data] is on, for a shader to read as [code]INSTANCE_CUSTOM[/code]. Copies without any have zeros.
The render layers the copies are drawn on, as [member VisualInstance3D.layers]: a camera or a reflection probe whose [code]cull_mask[/code] leaves them out doesn't draw them.
A material to draw every copy with instead of the mesh's own.

Every copy's transform in the node's own space, 12 floats each, in the order a [MultiMesh] buffer has them: the basis's rows, each followed by one coordinate of the origin ([code]basis.x.x, basis.y.x, basis.z.x, origin.x, basis.x.y, ...[/code]). The number of copies follows from its size; one whose size isn't a multiple of 12 is refused.
If [code]true[/code], each copy has a colour from [member colors].
If [code]true[/code], each copy has four numbers from [member custom_data].
Chunks further than this from the camera aren't drawn, in metres. [code]0[/code] draws them at any distance.
